question: Does the actual included-agent K1 construction procedure increase fully accepted fresh K2 workflow delivery over ordinary equal-content construction under equal access and resource limits?
selection_decision: Offer a composed digital outcome only if complete independently checked execution qualifies and collected modeled margin covers complete incurred costs. A conventional tie rejects a retained-method advantage; its ordinary construction remains eligible for conditional commerce.

development.role: Exposed development, never untouched confirmation; all actual included-agent probes/failed attempts retained and first-use resources charged.

confirmation.seeds: 100 through 123 inclusive, opaque IDs from frozen generator
confirmation.sampling: Complete fixed finite authored grid; not a sample of industrial sites or a calibrated market. No seed replacement, post-outcome repair or extended search.

arms: ordinary equal-content constructor (also the procedure-removal/content-preserving ablation)
equal_content: Both may use all K1 permitted facts, lessons, validated primitives, full constructor source and retained artifact. Ordinary may adapt independently with conventional methods and need not emulate treatment. Match access and maximum resource envelopes, disclose actual differing probes/CPU/observations.
primary_metric: Paired difference in fully accepted K2 tasks (each must accept all 16 admitted fault schedules). Report rejected, refused and unsafe outcomes separately, including every registered family.
material_effect: At least one additional fully accepted K2 task, no additional avoidable side-effect harm, and positive incremental modeled collected surplus after all extra first-use and reuse costs. Under the illustrative positive-demand cost envelope one K2 accepted sale nets $759.84 after fees/tax; an additional accepted sale may justify a limited construction expense only within those assumptions. No real willingness to pay or universal threshold is inferred.
secondary: diagnostic units and quoted unaffordable probes
maximum executor operation/time units across all admitted faults
total first-use K1 probes and all development corrections
process CPU and wall time, measured separately from modeled USD
native earned-funding provenance, complete costs, unrestricted cash and outstanding obligations
acceptance: Unchanged finite evaluator checks actual Python tool effects, exact recomputed data product, one effect per intent, prior acknowledged actual dependency token, deadline and pending-effect drain. Refusal is not accepted delivery. Finite validation is not a general contract proof for an unknown live service.
negative_regions: no idempotency with no finite in-flight/read guarantee
shared global key suppresses a required distinct intent
wrong content or unacknowledged dependency token
leakage: K1 archival to K2 reservation-dependent analysis is a family/operation-graph split, not rows of one archived output. All data authored. Coordinator inspects evaluator source. Constructor worker is conversation-separated and instructed to read only public contract/session observations; shared filesystem is not security isolation, independent institution or external blinding. No physical data or customers.
agent_generation: An actual included Codex worker observes development probes and generates constructor.py and its reusable settle primitive before this freeze. Offline replay executes the frozen code. There is no unattended model-call integration, no weight editing and no mock generator presented as model discovery.

native_link.requests: Predetermined K1 development request 0 and K2 confirmation request 0, fixed in requests.json before outcomes; never select a successful artifact after scoring.
native_link.production: Reconstruct after native reservation/order, do not sell a preconstructed target or reuse a technical-run artifact as funded production.
native_link.accounts: One canonical JournalAccount/adaptive Account per independent scenario; same account for K1/K2. Do not pool accounts. Fresh scenario accounts, never migrations.
native_link.capital: Primary $2,000 simulated equity; $1,000 registered underfunded control and $100,000 reference, all independent. Equity must cover collateral plus remaining production plus explicit fee; no actual financing.
native_link.costs: Exact frozen ECONOMIC_PLAN.json; modeled resource envelopes, sale fees, support and tax must be native incurred expenses. Measured billing remains unknown.
native_link.scenarios: Five primary cases (positive,weak-demand,adverse-cost,delayed-collection,post-research no-entry) plus underfunded and100k reference.
native_link.scale: Two offers per case maximum by finite study design, not a universal market cap. No annualization, $3B extrapolation or achieved profit milestone.
native_link.counterfactual_limit: The strict EARNED-only K2 resource policy tests financing provenance, not globally optimal financing or a ban on competent alternatives using seed. Equal-content ordinary K2 execution is the procedure-removal control. A direct conventional K2 route may already fit initial equity; no claim that K1 made K2 otherwise unreachable is preregistered.

stopping: Stop each registered task after its frozen procedure or resource/refusal boundary. Finish all declared cases once, preserve failures. Any integrity failure stops affected operation and is reported; do not tune and relabel fresh. A corrected new source would need a distinct registered cycle.
uncertainty: Report exact finite-grid paired effects and family ranges, not invented real-world probabilities or IID confidence intervals. Economics are conditional on independent price/demand/collection/cost assumptions and stronger conventional competition.
verdicts: commercial success without established discovery-method advantage
independent_review: Evaluator author, baseline author, constructor worker and financial reviewer separated procedurally on one shared host; key-free native replay in another process. No external experiment or certification.
publication: New owned branch and draft PR with sanitized public source and compact claim evidence; no private authority, formal approval, merge or release.
